capabilities: Read session logs from Claude Code, Codex and WorkBuddy
Render a day's token usage, cache reads/writes and plan-limit hits as a receipt
Estimate costs from an editable per-model price table
Export receipts as PNG, WebP or animated SVG, or embed them in notes
Browse receipts by day in a sidebar view with animated scenes
disambiguation: Not a token counter for your notes; it visualizes AI coding session usage read from logs stored outside the vault.
extras: Desktop only (reads logs via Node.js). Reads files outside the vault (~/.claude, ~/.codex, ~/.workbuddy, ~/.config/magpie) but never writes there and sends nothing over the network. Costs are estimates at API list prices, not what subscription users pay. Not yet in the community plugin store; installable manually or via BRAT, and not manually reviewed by Obsidian staff.
problem: Token usage and plan-limit data from AI coding tools sits in local session logs outside the vault, with no way to see a day's totals at a glance or keep them in notes.

relations.evidence: The idea comes from claude-receipts by Chris Hutchinson
The plugin reads, and never writes, the session logs in ~/.claude/projects (Claude Code)
Magpie, if you use it: the receipt adds what Magpie has recorded

requires.name: Claude Code, Codex or WorkBuddy session logs

summary: Reads local Claude Code, Codex and WorkBuddy session logs and renders a day's token usage, plan limits and estimated costs as a shop receipt.
